name: Obsidian-ZettelFlow
description: Build guided Canvas workflows, read PDFs and EPUBs, and turn highlights into cited notes connected to your local Zettelkasten and knowledge graph.

paragraphs: Practice loops · Reader & Library · Canvas workflows · Get started · Why ZettelFlow · Everything it does
Most plugins help you write. Almost none help you think.

Stop managing notes. Start managing knowledge. Obsidian is the store; ZettelFlow is the engine that makes the knowledge inside it evolve. It turns a native Canvas into a note-creation wizard, opens your notes, PDFs and EPUBs in a Reader built for thinking, and gives you a small set of practice loops that ask something of you. Every loop is offline, works with AI switched off, and writes nothing to your vault you did not decide.
features: ZettelFlow collects no telemetry and sends no personal data or vault contents anywhere. No account, no backend: the network is touched only by the opt-in paths below.
